facts.fact: The Instituto de Gestão da Qualidade e da Propriedade Intelectual (IGQPI) publishes the Lista de Normas Cabo-verdianas, a catalogue of national standards (NCV 001:2015 to NCV 025:2023), updated March 2024; the document does not state the law that set the body up.

The IGQPI catalogue of 25 national standards lists 21 agricultural, fisheries and food product standards (2015-2016) and four tourism standards (2020-2023), and holds no standard on information technology, information security, software or data.
